name: multi-part-disguise-attack
trigger: When a prompt contains a series of seemingly unrelated or benign tasks or topics, but includes a hidden sensitive instruction.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding sensitive instructions within a sequence of innocuous tasks or topics, making it appear as part of a larger, benign assignment.
guidance: Identify and isolate any sentences or parts that seem out of place or contain sensitive instructions, then evaluate the surrounding context for any hidden intent.
